headline: PIT @ OAK matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is PIT 5.80 at OAK 4.96, with a projected total of 10.77. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward PIT: PIT moved +1.29 runs while OAK moved +1.00, changing the projected margin by +0.28 runs. The projected total climbed +2.32, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -13.1%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Braxton Ashcraft has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Zack Gelof, Nick Kurtz, Shea Langeliers, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jeff McNeil because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
